root_cause_mappings.theme: Runtime proof, mutation proof, command safety, test realism, and false-green prevention

root_cause_mappings.theme: Goals graph, goal detail, and Today coupling integrity

root_cause_mappings.theme: Today, closure, and consequence loop authority
root_cause_mappings.proof_required: Closure before/action/after proof, Today recompute, restart replay, proof/undo artifact IDs, and accessible state change.

root_cause_mappings.theme: Proof, receipt, undo, fallback, and audit graph consistency

root_cause_mappings.proof_required: Forbidden-language screenshot proof, root/drilldown/overlay matrix, one primary product object, accessibility manual/device proof, and no root Motion/Capture drift.
